# Comprehensive synthetic EAF fixture

`comprehensive-eaf.pdf` is a deterministic, privacy-safe PDF made entirely from fake course data. It is shaped like the text and coordinate layout that the current PDF.js EAF parser consumes; it is not an official Archershub document and must never be used as real enrollment evidence.

The fixture contains 26 rows and 41 meetings. Forty meetings have a day, time, and location; one `NSTP101` meeting is explicitly asynchronous with no day, time, or venue. All scheduled meetings are globally non-overlapping so the complete `parseEafFile` path reaches timetable validation.

## Coverage

The rows cover the three normal paired patterns (Monday/Thursday, Tuesday/Friday, and Wednesday/Saturday), single-day PE and laboratory classes, a fully online pair, a hybrid online/F2F pair, F2F pairs with the same and different rooms, a pair with different days/times/rooms, late PM times, all NSTP source codes, and the Laguna room-code mappings `MM101`, `MM-BLACKBOX`, `MRR101`, `UH208`, `EKR101`, `RL101`, `LC1`, and `LC2`:

`NSTP101`, `NSTPCW1`, `NSTPCW2`, `NSTPLT1`, `NSTPLT2`, `NSTPRO1`, and `NSTPRO2`.

`expected.json` is the machine-readable contract. Its `rows` section contains the expected normalized parser output for each row, and its `coverage` section names the rows used to prove each state. The generator source is `generate_fixture.py`; changing the PDF requires regenerating it and rerunning the focused parser test.

## Regenerate and inspect

From the repository root, use the bundled workspace Python runtime with ReportLab:

```sh
/Users/hoshi/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3 \
  tests/fixtures/comprehensive-eaf/generate_fixture.py
pdfinfo tests/fixtures/comprehensive-eaf/comprehensive-eaf.pdf
pdftoppm -png -r 120 tests/fixtures/comprehensive-eaf/comprehensive-eaf.pdf \
  tmp/pdfs/comprehensive-eaf/page
```

The rendered pages should show a three-page table with a stable header, readable columns, no clipped text, and the fake-data footer. The parser test also imports the generated bytes through `parseEafFile`, so a visually plausible PDF that does not follow the parser's coordinate contract will fail.

## Validate

```sh
node --test tests/comprehensive-eaf.test.mjs
npm test
git diff --check -- tests/fixtures/comprehensive-eaf tests/comprehensive-eaf.test.mjs
```

The focused test checks the session, every row and meeting, building normalization, all coverage categories, and the no-overlap invariant. It also checks the async row's null schedule fields and verifies that all seven NSTP codes remain distinct.
